standard-dialogue-speaking-to-the-guard-.text: If the player has completed The Fremennik Isles:

standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.speaker: Rightie
standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.text: Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?

standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.speaker: Leftie
standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.text: Right, Rightie. So you'd be Leftie not Rightie, right?

standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.speaker: Leftie
standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.text: Rightie-oh Rightie, or should I call you Leftie?

standard-dialogue-speaking-to-a-guard-in.player: Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
